The '''skar'kla''', or '''skar-kla''', were a species of bipedal semiaquatic carnivorous reptile,<ref name="TOR-codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Skar'kla}}</ref> a lethal predator native to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]<ref name="guide" /> and [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Water Bounty" /> They were described as strong, fast, and deadly.<ref name="TOR-codex" />

==Anatomy==
Skar'klas had scaly hides and plated manes that offered protection from other predators, while their sharp teeth and powerful jaws allowed them to quickly devour their prey.<ref name="TOR-codex" /> Their skin also defended them from toxic environment, allowing them to live in acid lakes.<ref name="Caustic Cascade" /> Being bipedal, skar'klas could use their strong arms to attack. They had three fingers on each arm and four on each leg, each ending with a big claw.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>

A legend persists that skar'klas find relief in having the undersides of their mane plates scratched, but so far no one has been known to dare attempt to confirm it.<ref name="TOR-codex" />

==Behavior and habitat==
Skar'las lived near water and thrived in wet, tropical climes,<ref name="TOR-codex" /> but had subpopulations acclimatized to lush forests, savannas and warm valleys.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Skar'klas hunted in packs of three or four. Their hunt packs often had a "pack leader" almost twice the size of a normal skar'kla.<ref name="Caustic Cascade">{{TORcite|Caustic Cascade|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> An underground subtype of Skar'kla was a stealthy hunter relying on quick attacks, hiding beneath the surface to ambush its prey by bursting from underground.<ref name="Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the [[Jedi Enclave|Enclave]]}}</ref>

==History== 
On [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the decrease in numbers of krak'jya, another common predator, hunted down for pelts, resulted in skar'kla leaking to the lowlands. Despite the fear of civilization, skar'klas have been known to attack lone individuals in the wilderness.<ref name="guide" />

On [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], skar'klas were hunted by [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], who built hunting traps and used [[grophet]] meat to attract them.

The ruins of the [[Jedi Enclave|Jedi Academy]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] were overrun by underground skar'klas by the [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> when the [[Alliance Commander]] was exploring it [[Mission to the Jedi Enclave|searching]] for [[Darth Malgus]].

A population of skar'kla was onboard of a [[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]] that [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>. Surviving skar'klas inhabited [[Geothermal Disruption]], one of the terraformed zones of the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]] created by [[Jannimak]] automatic systems. There they lived near acid lakes, attacking both Jannimak droids and [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors investigating the area.<ref name="Caustic Cascade" /><ref name="Acid Trip">{{TORcite|Acid Trip|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Glitterclaw.png|left|thumb|An illustration from the [[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]]]
Term Skar'kla, from [[Bothese]] "Glitterclaw", was first used in [[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]] as a name of a relative to the [[krak'jya]] feline Bothawui mountain predator. It was described as having a slate gray to white camouflaging [[Hair|fur]] which gave the creature its name. The illustration in the guide, however, made by [[Chris Trevas]], depicted them completely different,<ref name="guide" /> similar to how skar'klas would later look in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]], in which the name was used for a creature of completely reimagined appearance and behavior. In the game, both skar'klas and krak'jyas were introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|Shadow of Revan]] expansion, as creatures native to jungles of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="TOR" /> Despite the species being majorly retconned, this article still assumes the information from the guide that has not yet been directly refuted, such as its partially [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] origin, to be true.
